A base model ID routes the gateway to InvokeModel with an Anthropic body. Bodies keep the long-standing Messages API fields (stop_details, service_tier, speed and inference_geo are left out because their presence on Bedrock is unverified). Bedrock-specific details: msg_bdrk_/toolu_bdrk_ ids, model "claude-opus-5-5" in the body, and amazon-bedrock-invocationMetrics on the final message_stop chunk are from memory of real Bedrock responses, not from a page read this session. Ids, signatures, token counts and text are invented. Replace each case with a recorded capture (source: recorded) when the live recorder runs. Error cases (error_service_quota, stream_error_access_denied) and mid-stream exceptions (stream_exception_*) follow the Bedrock Runtime Smithy model's exception shapes and HTTP statuses, the restJson1 error protocol (exception name in the x-amzn-ErrorType header, members in the JSON body) and the ResponseStream exception members; see each case.json. Their messages and request IDs are invented.
